title: Empact
tagline: A social impact platform using influencers and DAO voting mechanisms to boost social impact campaigns.
description:
We have created an social impact platform built on web3 technologies that is focused on helping social impact organizations reach their goals.

We want to empower activists to promote issues that matter, while driving their audiences to positive action.

Our platform is built to leverage social impact initiatives through democratic DAO-governed voting, and by compensating influencer activists that help to spread the actions.
how_its_made:
We used EPNS to handle notifying the DAO when campaigns are submitted for review. We are also using EPNS to notify our activist influencers whenever a campaign is published that share the same values that the activist has.

To publish the social media post we used Lenster.

The ides was to also use additional proof of identity protocols to authenticate campaigns before being published for review.
